items.question: How is the cosmic serpent bound by true devotees' meditation and worship?
premises: True devotees' meditation fetters the serpent.
items.inference: Devotional meditation and worship together bind cosmic power.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the restrained subject is not stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: Fettered by the meditation of true devotees, restrained by the water of worship.
